purpose: The same two seeded pairs as s03, with the two suppressors s03 exposed removed and nothing else changed: no channel between the agents, and an ownership boundary enforced by the sandbox rather than by the brief.
changes_from_s03: coop setting replaced by two independent solo runs: no mailbox, no shared team git remote
agent A runs in an image with the consumer module and its runtime dependents removed, verified to contain the consumer's method name nowhere
agent B runs in the full image with the provider's source bind-mounted read-only at the base commit
briefs, graded test patches, grading and classification unchanged
